opening.argument: The strongest signal is the report's critical framing: the narration says OneCoin's value will not rise and raises concerns about the product. A presenter at a news desk and an interview subject shown beside OneCoin branding place those claims in a news and interview setting. The founder's optimism is presented as an interview statement, not as a promise from the video to its viewers; the speaker expressly says he cannot guarantee it. Although OneCoin material appears on screen, that does not turn the report into a creator-led request to invest. The promotional branding and contact details at the sampled ending likewise do not establish a concrete request for viewers to send money or data.

citations.quote: One of the newest virtual currencies, OneCoin, is haunting normal people but it's value will not rise anyway.
OneCoin's founder himself is abusing the product.
I cannot guarantee, but I'm extremely optimistic.
